subject: Activation score & role cadence — Aurora mutual plan
messages:
From: Emma Zhang <emma@auroratech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan / high-level timeline for Aurora activation

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the model routing options. We're moving toward an internal alignment meeting next Friday and would like a short mutual action plan that maps milestones, owners, and target dates so we can show execs a concrete runway. Key asks from our side:

- A 6–8 week timeline to pilot (targeting data onboarding + two intents).
- Clear owners for infra/ingest, prompt engineering, and integration testing.
- Any compliance evidence we need to share with procurement early (SOC2/audit logs).

Could you send a draft MAP and a proposed kickoff date? If possible, include a one-page milestone cadence we can paste into our slide deck.

Appreciate it — Emma

Emma Zhang
Director, Product Integrations | Aurora Tech
[Attachment: customer_requirements_summary.pdf (pdf, 88 KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhang <emma@auroratech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 12:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan / high-level timeline for Aurora activation

Emma — thanks for the clear asks.

I've attached a first-pass MAP (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short summary SOW draft for procurement. High level below; please let me know if anything needs to shift.

Proposed pilot runway (6 weeks):
1) Week 0 (kickoff week): Project kickoff + data access + security review (owners: Redwood AM: Marcus, Aurora IT: Emma).
2) Weeks 1–2: Data mapping & ingestion (owners: Aurora infra / Redwood solutions - Ben).
3) Week 3: Prompt engineering + test prompts for two target intents (owners: Redwood ML + Aurora PM).
4) Week 4: Integration testing + acceptance criteria validation (owners: Aurora QE + Redwood eng).
5) Week 5: Performance tuning & quantization recommendation (owners: Redwood infra).
6) Week 6: Pilot sign-off and go/no-go decision (owners: Aurora exec sponsor + Marcus).

Immediate asks from our side:
- Please confirm Aurora's desired kickoff week (we currently have Aug 11 as an open slot).
- Share a technical contact with access to S3 bucket details or equivalent.
- Procurement: who should I loop in for SOW redlines?

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone dates and RACI), SOW_Aurora_draft.pdf (procurement stub).

I'll loop in Monica and Ben for refinement — Monica, Ben: two quick calls or edits to the sheet and we can send a client-ready slide.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan / high-level timeline for Aurora activation

Marcus / Ben — quick internal notes after skimming Marcus's draft:

- Swap Week 3 and Week 4 order: we should do an initial integration smoke test earlier (end of Week 2) to validate connectivity before heavy prompt work. Saves rework.
- Assign Redwood eng owner for monitoring: suggest "Ben Carter" for day-to-day infra during pilot, and "Monica Patel" for adoption runbooks and acceptance criteria sign-off.
- Compliance: procurement will want a SOC2 attestation AND a short note about audit-log retention. I'll prepare a one-page evidence bundle.

Proposed edits to MAP:
- Kickoff: Aug 18 (gives Aurora one week to finalize internal stakeholders).
- Data access: target within 3 business days of kickoff.
- Acceptance criteria: define 3 KPIs — intent accuracy baseline, average token latency SLA, and error-free integration flows.

Ben — can you add a monitoring checklist and failover plan to the MAP spreadsheet? I can add the acceptance criteria table and the compliance checklist.

Thanks — M.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Emma — attaching the updated MAP with Monica and Ben's edits applied. Summary of changes and next steps below.

What changed (high level):
- Kickoff moved to Aug 18 per Monica's availability note.
- Data access target tightened to 3 business days post-kickoff; monitoring checklist added (Ben).
- Integration smoke test moved earlier to validate connectivity before full prompt pass.
- One-page evidence bundle (SOC2 + audit-log retention statement) is in the SOW draft for procurement.

Next steps:
1) Can Aurora confirm internal stakeholders and technical contact by Aug 6? (we need that to provision access).
2) I'll schedule a 60-minute kickoff workshop for Aug 18 (calendar invite to follow) focused on data handoff, security checklist, and success criteria.
3) Procurement: please share the procurement contact for SOW redlines; we can accept comments via DocuSign/Google Doc.

Attached: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW_Aurora_draft.pdf.

If that looks good I'll convert the MAP into the one-slide deck Emma requested and send to you by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
